title: ALMA Observations of the Sub-kpc Structure of the Host Galaxy of a z = 6.5 Lensed Quasar: A Rotationally Supported Hyper-Starburst System at the Epoch of Reionization
question: What are the sub-kpc spatial structure, lensing configuration, physical properties, and gas kinematics of the host galaxy of the z=6.51 gravitationally lensed quasar J0439+1634?

what.value: Fiducial HST lens model parameters (lens redshift 0.67, mass 2.06x10^10 M_sun, ellipticity 0.65, PA 94.58 deg, quasar magnification 51.3 +/- 1.4) and SMBH mass M_BH = (4.29 +/- 0.60) x 10^8 M_sun

evidence.quote: The lensing model based on *HST* data suggests that J0439+1634 is a naked-cusp lens with three images, with a total magnification of $51.3\pm1.4$.
$^{1}$ In the default model, the parameters of the lens galaxy, except its position, are fixed to the fiducial model in (cite: fan19).
(cite: fan19) measures the SMBH mass of J0439+1634 to be $M_\text{BH}=(4.29\pm 0.60)\times10^8M_\odot$, which gives $M_\text{BH}/M_\text{dyn}=0.055\sin^2(i)$.

what.value: Apparent (un-corrected for lensing) infrared luminosities, emission line luminosities, SFR, dust mass, and CO-based molecular gas mass

evidence.quote: Based on these measurements, (cite: yang19) calculate the infrared luminosities, emission line luminosities, star formation rate, dust mass, and gas mass without correcting for the lensing magnification.
Table notes: These values are calculated according to Table 1 in (cite: yang19).

recipe.goal: Calibrate visibilities, subtract continuum, and image continuum and [C II] line
recipe.method: Fit linear continuum to line-free channels with UVCONTSUB, perform phase self-calibration on continuum and apply to line visibilities, and clean both using TCLEAN with Briggs weighting.

recipe.goal: Extract lensed continuum and [C II] fluxes and fit 1D [C II] line profile
recipe.method: Extract continuum and [C II] fluxes using a 2.0'' diameter aperture and fit a 1D Gaussian profile to the [C II] spectrum using SPECFIT.

recipe.goal: Model gravitational lensing and source surface brightness in the uv-plane
recipe.method: Use VISILENS to fit an SIE lens + Sérsic source model directly to the continuum and [C II] visibilities using MCMC. In the default model, fix lens mass, ellipticity, and PA to the HST fiducial model, fit lens position on continuum, and fix lens position for [C II].
key_parameters: Lens redshift = [0.67], Source redshift = [6.5187], Lens Mass = [2.06x10^10 M_sun], Lens e = [0.65], Lens PA = [94.58 deg] (in default model)
assumptions: Singular isothermal ellipsoid (SIE) lens mass distribution and single Sérsic source profile

recipe.goal: Reconstruct source-plane [C II] data cube, moment maps, and kinematics
recipe.method: Attempt uv-plane axisymmetric thin rotating disk fit with VISILENS (rejected due to poor fit). Reconstruct source-plane data cube via inverse ray-tracing of the cleaned image cube onto a 0.04'' grid using the default lens model, compute moment maps for pixels with SNR > 10, and extract PV diagram.
key_parameters: integrated flux SNR > 10 threshold for moment 1 and 2
assumptions: Default lensing model mapping from image plane to source plane

recipe.goal: Derive de-lensed physical properties, spatially resolved [C II] deficit, and dynamical mass
recipe.method: Correct apparent luminosities, SFR, dust mass, and gas mass from (cite: yang19) using derived continuum and [C II] magnifications. Measure [C II]/FIR vs Sigma_FIR in 4 concentric elliptical rings of width R_eff. Compute dynamical mass from v_max sin(i) and r_max, and evaluate SMBH sphere of influence.
assumptions: LambdaCDM cosmology with H0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_M = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7
Dust continuum traces molecular gas (for CO magnification) and SFR surface density

score_reason: The ALMA project code, CASA versions, spectral setup, and lens modeling software (VISILENS) with fixed and free parameters are clearly documented. However, low-level imaging/self-calibration parameters, the exact phase center reference coordinates for Table 1, and the custom ray-tracing script are not provided.
rediscovery_reason: Public archival dataset (2018.1.00566.S) of a high-SNR target with clear numeric benchmarks: aperture fluxes, 1D Gaussian line parameters, VISILENS SIE+Sérsic magnifications and effective radii, and kinematic v_max sin(i).
